blocks.text: A woman riding a horse while raising a bolo sword, fighting for her country and for the love of her life that was taken too early. Long before “heroine” became a title, María Josefa Gabriela Silang stepped forward, took command, and led the revolution herself. She fought not just for herself but for every Filipino who deserves to be free. With her legacy, ‘Gabriela: The Musical’ intends to show how she emerged as one of the important figures and pillars of Filipina womanhood.
